label: life
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: THREE separate tall portrait game backgrounds arranged as equal-width columns side by side, without gutters, frames or dividing rules. Each portrait is approximately 1:2.16, overall canvas approximately 3:2.16. Create full rectangular paintings, NOT icons. The supplied images are style/continuity references: luminous opaque gouache, selective fine ink, lapis, jade, burnt ochre, muted coral, warm ivory light. Monumental and intimate, a world being created, never a settlement. No text, numbers, words, ornamental borders, people unless explicitly specified, buildings, UI or watermark. Place dramatic landmarks mainly in the UPPER 42 percent of EACH portrait; the LOWER 58 percent must be a spacious calm medium-LIGHT desaturated blue-grey/ochre painted foreground with sparse broad atmospheric strokes, giving dark circular tokens readable working space. This calm area belongs naturally to each painting, not a rectangular UI panel or flat overlay. Preserve the three equal portrait panels. Recurring geography when visible: hooked ochre headland at upper left, a single arched cave at its foot when the requested era permits a cave, teal tidal inlet, pale dry rock shelf on the RIGHT inside the entrance and a broad dry upper interior wall above the tidal wash. The dry shelf is connected to exposed rock at the mouth, visibly above the water; do not flood the whole floor. Distant jagged coastal hills, pale Moon with a pair of adjacent unequal craters, consistent with reference. No actual Earth map. LEFT: Same still-bare hooked coast with NO cave opening, low layered stromatolite domes at the waterline, thin green microbial mats in shallow tidal pools, a clear blue atmosphere. NO land plants, animals, fish, trees, flowers or people. Ancient microbes quietly changing a planet. Calm pale wet sand and sea below. CENTER: Same coast BEFORE the cave is hollowed, solid ochre cliff. View across clear shallow water with a few soft-bodied marine forms and simple pale shells on underwater rocks; sparse ribbon-like green algae rather than a kelp forest. NO coral reef, no land plants or animals, no cave or arch, no people. Much open sea and bare shore. RIGHT: Same coast AFTER its cave and first land forest exist. Tall fern-like trees with straight trunks and splayed fronds mantle the upper ridge around the familiar cave. Dense lush fern understory, but NO flowers, grass meadow, birds, land animals, humans, mushroom clusters or fallen forest. Dry cave shelf visible; lower field calm open shoreline.
